scope: Assigned professional packages: default demo viewport only; actual image review, no interaction replay or full state/size/density acceptance.
method: Every listed image was opened with view_image. Exact PNG SHA-256 was recalculated; case fingerprints were linked to worker inputs, all before/after records and their serialized-record digests were checked.

summary.otherPackages: Not reviewed here; original cases.json statuses left unchanged.
